question: Five solid cubes, each of volume 512000 cm³ , are joined end to end to form a cuboid. What is the lateral surface area (in cm² ) of the cuboid?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Side of one cube (a) = (512000)¹/³ = 80 cm.

When 5 cubes are joined in a row, the lateral surface comprises exactly 12 square faces (5 front, 5 back, 1 left, 1 right).

Area of 1 square face = a² = 80 × 80 = 6400 cm².

Lateral Surface Area = 12 × 6400 = 76800 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 76800 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Volume of each solid cube = 512000 cm³

Number of cubes joined end-to-end = 5

**Formula Used:**

Volume of cube = a³

Lateral Surface Area of cuboid = 2 × h × (l + b)

 Cuboid formed by 5 Cubes
 Lateral Surface Area = 12 × a² = 76800 cm²

**Calculations:**

⇒ a³ = 512000

⇒ a = (512000)¹/³ = 80 cm

⇒ For the new cuboid formed:

⇒ Length (l) = 5 × 80 = 400 cm

⇒ Breadth (b) = 80 cm

⇒ Height (h) = 80 cm

⇒ Lateral Surface Area = 2 × 80 × (400 + 80)

⇒ Lateral Surface Area = 160 × 480 = 76800 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 76800 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Resulting Cuboid

When 'n' identical cubes of side 'a' are joined end-to-end, TSA = 2(n + n + 1)a² = (4n + 2)a².

Volume of Resulting Cuboid

The total volume remains the sum of the volumes of the individual cubes: V = n × a³.

Diagonal of the Resulting Cuboid

Diagonal = √(l² + b² + h²) = √((na)² + a² + a²) = a√(n² + 2).
